resources.string: Adaptive interactive live wallpaper designed for Android tablets (sw600dp+).
DiyarDesk Android is designed for tablets (600dp+ screen width). On phone-sized screens animation density or layout may be constrained.
Drag boxes to match where your launcher icons and widgets sit. Themes react and leave space around them. Double-tap a box to remove it.
Icon layout updated on live wallpaper
Open system Wallpaper settings and choose DiyarDesk from Live Wallpapers.
Use built-in theme sound or import a video/HTML theme package.
Grant overlay permission so DiyarDesk can float translucent boxes directly on top of your real home screen icons and widgets.
Drag boxes onto your icons and tap Save when done.
Tap empty space to add icon · Drag box to move · Drag corner dot to resize · Double-tap box to delete
